title: Every nervous first-timer says the same thing
why: Warm leads stuck on fear (tipping, swimming, bats, family fit); real TripAdvisor lines answer each objection so they book instead of bailing.
hook_options: Every nervous first-timer says the same thing
Scared at first. Then this happened.
Never kayaked? Read what first-timers wrote after.
caption: We read the reviews. The fear always shows up in sentence one: tipping, swimming, the bats, the kids. By sentence two it's gone. Scared is normal. Paddle lesson on land, life vest the whole trip, guide right beside you. Send this to your nervous friend. #austinkayak #firsttimekayaking #ladybirdlake #austinkayaktours

slides.headline: Every nervous first-timer says the same thing
slides.body: We read the reviews. The fear shows up in sentence one. It's gone by sentence two.

slides.headline: "It was scary initially"
slides.body: "...but a great experience once you get the hang of it." Calm water, stable kayaks, and a paddling lesson before launch.

slides.headline: "The life savers made me relax"
slides.body: Full quote: "the presence of life savers made me relax and enjoy the experience." Life vests on everyone, the whole trip.

slides.headline: "The bats were SO COOL!!!"
slides.body: Capital letters theirs. The colony flies out overhead at dusk, hunting insects, uninterested in you.

slides.headline: "Will this work for my whole family?"
Ages 6 to 69, one trip
slides.body: "My family of 8, ranged from age 6-69... This was perfect for the older kids." Tours are ages 5 and up.

slides.kicker: Send this to your nervous friend
slides.headline: Scared is normal. Go anyway.
slides.body: Paddle lesson on land, life vest on, guide right beside you. Book at austinkayaktours.com.
